Government of Bangladesh: The Ministry of Finance and the Internal Resources Division act as the government authority issuing official regulatory notifications regarding customs and value added tax matters.
Internal Resources Division: This division of the Ministry of Finance is the issuing body for official customs and value added tax regulatory orders.
Ministry of Finance: The Ministry of Finance oversees the Internal Resources Division and serves as the parent government department for customs and tax-related administration.
Customs: This department or regulatory area is subject to official government notification and fiscal policy oversight by the Ministry of Finance.
Value Added Tax: This tax area falls under the administrative jurisdiction of the Internal Resources Division and is subject to official government notifications.

Customs Act 1969: Section 19(1) of the Act empowers the Government to issue notifications and amend existing orders in the public interest, following consultation with the National Board of Revenue.
Value Added Tax Act 1991: Section 14(1) of this Act provides the legal authority for the Government to amend tax-related notifications in consultation with the National Board of Revenue.
National Board of Revenue: The Board acts as the consultative body that must be consulted by the Government when exercising its legal powers to issue or amend customs and VAT-related notifications.
S.R.O. 151-AIN/2016: This existing notification is subjected to a further amendment through this current regulatory order.
